name: Big number: lower third, the digits rise
when: The voice gives one striking figure on its own (a cost, sales, views, a price, a count, a size: "over 170 animal species") and the footage under it should stay the subject. The source box lands first at the lower left (caption5-A's, with the outlet's logo), then the figure's characters rise one after the other through the line they stand on, and the label slides out from behind the figure on the same baseline, so figure and label read as one line ("170+ animal species"). Covers little of the shot. Not for two figures compared (statbars) or a figure in a list (listcounter2).
anchor: `at` is the figure's first word in the voice-over: the characters start to rise there and the figure stands complete about 0.4 s plus 0.05 s per character later; the source box lands 0.17 s before `at`. The scene ends 0.23 s after `out`.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.currency: the currency sign before the figure when the voice says an amount of money ($, €, £); set small, its top on the digits' cap height. Empty = none
vars.figure: the figure exactly as the voice says it, in digits with its separators, 9 characters at most: 975,000 / 170 / 3.9 / 235. Never a number the voice does not say, and never one rounded differently (it appears whole, it never counts up)
vars.unit: one letter after the figure, full size: M (million), B (billion), K (thousand) or %; empty = none ("90 million" = figure 90, unit M)
vars.plus: true when the voice says over, more than, at least (a small + after the figure); false otherwise
vars.label: what the figure counts, as the voice says it, on the figure's baseline: animal species / copies sold / for the Vice City sign. Sentence case, 24 characters at most. Empty = the figure alone
vars.source: the words before the outlet in the source box: Confirmed by, Reported by, Estimated by
vars.outlet: the outlet's name (Game Informer). Shown as text when there is no logo, else the logo's alt text. Empty (and no logo) = no source box: the figure and its label alone
vars.logo: the outlet's logo file: build_video.mjs fills it from the repo's assets/logos/ when the outlet is listed in logos.json (or give a file the user supplied); empty = the sentence ends on the outlet's name as text. Never drawn or invented
vars.logo_h: the logo's height in px, as logos.json gives it (logo_h): about 38 for a wordmark, 30 for a very long one (Game Informer), 44 for IGN, 61 for a square mark (Rockstar, Take-Two)
vars.logo_trim: px taken off the box's right padding after the logo, as logos.json gives it: 14 for a square mark, else 0
vars.at: seconds after the start: the figure's first word (the characters start to rise); at least 0.1667. Default 0.3667: start the scene 0.37 s before that word
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later). Hold the landed figure at least 2 s

source: new, built in the skills repo (lot 6, 17 Nov 2026); demo in algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/bignumber2/
changed: New. The source box and the soft lower-left dim are caption5-A's (the dim a little larger for the figure). The figure is 176 px (a display numeral, like yearstamp-A's 168 px year), the label 44 px. Every character lands in 0.4 s, 1 to 1.5 frames apart (0.27 s spread at most), then holds still.
